habilidades_en: Cosmo of Hope — Whenever one or more Athena Devotees you control survive combat during your opponent's turn, generate 1 Latent Cosmo.

habilidades_en: When Seiya attacks, you may pay 1 Latent Cosmo. If you do, Seiya gets +1/+0 until end of turn.
